english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Five Saviours, the Resurrectors of Those Who Are Dead, Together with the Five Resurrections
english_classification.chapter_note: Heavily lacunose pentadic enumeration of five cosmic resurrectors. The oldest teaching layer dominates — a systematic five-fold enumeration where each resurrector is identified and their cosmic function described. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system (cosmic figures performing cosmic processes: gathering lives, drawing powers, standing them up). The low teaching purity score (0.167) reflects the vocabulary counter's inability to detect this content as substrate since it lacks the typical zoomorphic/metal/taste markers — but the structure is unmistakably systematic cosmological teaching. Only the formulaic opening (dialogue frame) and beatitude closure (exhortation) are later layers.
